def facts():
    b = Buffer("KTPU", 32, dtypes.half).allocate()
    st = b._buf
    st.valid, st.dtype = {FM.F16}, np.dtype(np.float32)
    raw = np.arange(32, dtype=np.float16).tobytes()
    TinyDevice["KTPU"].allocator._copyin(st, memoryview(raw))
    out = {
        "valid": form_keys(st),
        "host": st.host == raw,
        "dtype": st.dtype,
        "bytes": DEV.read(st.addr, 64) == raw,
    }
    b.deallocate()
    return out
